lifecycles._note: FIRST ANALYSIS 2026-06-20. ALL 4 product endpoints are read-only GETs (no mutations, no heavy prereqs). The product catalog is a global account-scoped meta-service — it returns SCP's own product/category registry. listproductcategories (GET /v1/product-categories) -> 200 count:14 categories (string slugs like FINANCIAL_MANAGEMENT, SECURITY). listproducts (GET /v1/products) -> 200 count:20 products (product_id string slugs like ESS, PRICING, SECRETSMANAGER). No required query params on either list. showproduct (GET /v1/products/{product_id}) uses product_id captured from $.products[0].product_id (sidecar produced_by: platform/product/listproducts). showproductcategory (GET /v1/product-categories/{category_id}) uses category_id from $.product_categories[0].category_id (sidecar produced_by: platform/product/listproductcategories). All 4 confirmed 200 live 2026-06-20. IDs are human-readable slugs, NOT UUIDs. No query params required. Pure read-only catalog service.

steps.name: list-product-categories
steps._note: listproductcategories: 200 count:14. Response envelope: {count, current_page, product_categories:[{category_id, display_name, ...}]}. category_id is a string slug (e.g. FINANCIAL_MANAGEMENT, SECURITY). Captured for showproductcategory probe_reads.

steps.name: list-products
steps._note: listproducts: 200 count:20. Response envelope: {count, current_page, products:[{product_id, display_name, product_category_id, kind, ...}], total_count, total_pages}. product_id is a string slug (e.g. ESS, PRICING, SECRETSMANAGER). Captured for showproduct probe_reads.

steps.name: show-product-category
steps._note: showproductcategory: 200 with real category_id slug (e.g. SECURITY). category_id captured from list-product-categories step ($.product_categories[0].category_id). Confirmed live 2026-06-20.

steps.name: show-product
steps._note: showproduct: 200 with real product_id slug (e.g. ESS). product_id captured from list-products step ($.products[0].product_id). Confirmed live 2026-06-20.
